note: Spelling variants merged in analyses after the census paper (companion work from 2026-09-28). analyze.py does not apply this map, so the published numbers (tag consensus-arxiv-v2) are unchanged. Apply it after norm() and the plural merge. Found by a string-similarity scan of all 31 categories plus a check of multi-word answers (2026-09-28); near-matches that are different words (serenity/serendipity, bee/beetle, basketball/baseball, pine/pineapple) are deliberately not merged.

expanded.note: Expanded battery (1.0-expanded): forms of one multi-word name that norm()'s last-word rule splits apart, merged to the most common form. analyze.answers() applies this map to the expanded battery only. Generated 2026-10-01 from multi-word replies seen at least twice, then reviewed; ambiguous last words (retriever, lake, dragon) are deliberately not merged.
